ops.title: Cadence review: enforce promises only for positive every values
ops.description:
Owner: j6563-cadence change owner.
Evidence at HEAD c86d7e9ba5c544b31b1961eab0e6ee1fda56d4a6: talk.py:476 selects every by truthiness; cli.py:6183 and cli.py:6293 accept any int for --every, and cli.py:445/935 persist it. An order with --every -1 therefore makes latest precede at at talk.py:480, while cli.promised_due at cli.py:1466 only returns due > at. No ordinary post can satisfy the check. The stated contract is every > 0, also used by watch.py:2351.
Next step: select only positive cadences in uncadenced and add coverage for negative values beside positive values. Review was static; no tests were run.

ops.text: Zero and negative every values do not activate uncadenced or tighten another order's positive cadence.
Positive every values still enforce the smallest positive cadence of the thread.
